_readme: One entry per person. photo: path under /assets/img/team/ or empty string to show the reserved circular slot. Titles follow the team reference render in the requirements doc (CEO / President / CSO). Links: leave empty strings for ones not to be shown.

zh.title: 既能做实验，也能训模型
zh.lede: 科学与前沿 AI 研究出身的团队：把科学问题、数据与实验反馈，接进同一条发现链路。
nodes: 从真实的未知出发，把问题转化为可研究、可验证的形式。
围绕 DFM 的能力定义，让模型在科学任务与真实反馈中学习。
调用工具、数据与实验环境，让判断接受现实检验。
把每一次结果沉淀为下一次发现的起点。
zh.join_body: 我们在寻找既关心科学问题、也愿意亲手构建系统的研究者与工程师。

en.title: People who can run the experiment and train the model
en.lede: A team from science and frontier AI research, connecting scientific questions, data and experimental feedback into one discovery loop.
nodes: Start from a real unknown and turn it into a researchable, verifiable question.
Within DFM's capability definition, let models learn from scientific tasks and real feedback.
Call tools, data and experimental environments so judgements meet reality.
Turn every result into the starting point of the next discovery.
en.join_body: We are looking for researchers and engineers who care about scientific questions and want to build the systems themselves.

zh.name: 吴英成
zh.title: 联合创始人 · CEO
zh.affiliation: 斯坦福大学 AI 博士后 · 复旦大学
zh.bio: 科学背景出身，现在斯坦福从事 AI for Science 研究，方向包括生物医学世界模型与自主实验室，以共同第一作者身份在 Cell、Nature、Science 发表工作。关注如何让真实的科学问题、实验数据与验证条件进入下一代智能系统。
research: AI for 生命科学与生物医学
肿瘤微环境与免疫图谱

en.name: Yingcheng Wu
en.title: Co-founder & CEO
en.affiliation: AI postdoctoral scholar, Stanford · Fudan University
en.bio: From a science background, now working on AI for Science at Stanford, on biomedical world models and autonomous labs, with co-first-author papers in Cell, Nature and Science. Focused on bringing real scientific questions, experimental data and verification conditions into next-generation intelligent systems.
research: AI for life science and biomedicine

zh.name: 杨灵
zh.title: 联合创始人 · CSO
zh.affiliation: 普林斯顿大学博士后 · 北京大学（即将入职）
zh.bio: 普林斯顿大学 ECE 博士后，即将加入北京大学任助理教授。研究大模型与智能体后训练、强化学习系统、递归自我改进与 Discovery Intelligence。创建开源研究社区 Gen-Verse，相关项目在 GitHub 与 Hugging Face 累计达到千万级使用量；担任 ICLR、ICML、NeurIPS 领域主席。代表工作包括 RLAnything、ReasonFlux、Buffer of Thoughts、MMaDA。
research: 大模型 / 智能体后训练
强化学习系统与基础设施

en.name: Ling Yang
en.title: Co-founder & CSO
en.affiliation: Postdoctoral researcher, Princeton · Incoming faculty, Peking University
en.bio: Postdoctoral researcher in ECE at Princeton and incoming assistant professor at Peking University. Works on LLM and agent post-training, reinforcement-learning systems, recursive self-improvement and discovery intelligence. Founded the open-source research community Gen-Verse, whose projects have reached tens of millions of cumulative uses across GitHub and Hugging Face; serves as Area Chair for ICLR, ICML and NeurIPS. Representative work includes RLAnything, ReasonFlux, Buffer of Thoughts and MMaDA.

zh.name: 尹榛菲
zh.title: 联合创始人 · President
zh.affiliation: 牛津大学博士后 · 悉尼大学博士
zh.bio: 牛津大学博士后研究员，博士毕业于悉尼大学；此前是上海人工智能实验室研究员，读博前在商汤科技 AGI 团队工作。研究方向是用基础模型构建能在物理世界与虚拟世界中行动的智能体，覆盖多模态推理、具身智能、多智能体系统，以及面向自动化科学发现的 AI Scientist 系统，代表工作包括开源多智能体机器人框架 MARS。
research: AI Scientist 与自动化科学发现

en.name: Zhenfei Yin
en.title: Co-founder & President
en.affiliation: Postdoctoral researcher, Oxford · PhD, University of Sydney
en.bio: Postdoctoral researcher at the University of Oxford and a PhD graduate of the University of Sydney; previously a research fellow at Shanghai AI Laboratory, and part of SenseTime's AGI group before the PhD. Works on foundation models that build AI agents for the physical and virtual world, spanning multimodal reasoning, embodied intelligence, multi-agent systems and AI Scientist systems for automated scientific discovery; representative work includes the open-source multi-agent robotics framework MARS.
research: AI Scientist systems and automated scientific discovery
